fields.description: Buy a gift certificate for eye, brow or aquarelle lip micropigmentation in Bucharest – give your wife or girlfriend a Studio LBar voucher for a special occasion

tvs.sub-title-bl8-interial: Pick it up at our studio or order delivery by courier
tvs.description-banner-inerial:
Looking for a special, memorable gift for your girlfriend, mother, wife, daughter, grandmother or colleague for a special occasion? Consider it found. A gift certificate for micropigmentation – semi-permanent makeup on any area or powder brows – will outshine any other gift.
Remember that every woman wants to look well-groomed and youthful at all times. Cosmetic tattooing can successfully correct any imperfection. Plus, semi-permanent brow makeup and powder brows never lose their appeal over the years and will always be within reach.

Terms for buying a permanent makeup gift certificate:

  • The minimum value of the certificate is 400 RON, with no limit on higher amounts. You can buy a voucher for a cosmetic tattoo on one, two or three areas at Studio LBar in Bucharest.
  • The gift certificate is valid for 1 year from the date of purchase.
  • It is valid for all techniques: powder brows, eyebrow micropigmentation, aquarelle lip tattoo, eyeliner tattoo or semi-permanent eyelid makeup.
  • The voucher is valid for adults only.
  • The certificate cannot be forged – it carries a custom holographic sticker. It comes packed in a Studio LBar gift envelope.

A gift like this brings the recipient genuine joy. Permanent makeup can transform your appearance, highlight your best features and camouflage minor flaws. It was created to give beauty and self-confidence. Buy a cosmetic tattoo voucher in Bucharest, and we'll send it by courier to any town in the country.
